# Funput

> Funput là bộ gõ tiếng Việt mã nguồn mở, nhẹ và tập trung vào quyền riêng tư. Gõ Telex hoặc VNI trên iOS, Android, macOS, Windows và Linux — từ máy tính đến điện thoại.

## Summary

Funput (Funput IME) is an open-source Vietnamese input method. It lets people type Vietnamese with Telex or VNI on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and Linux. Desktop builds are available from GitHub Releases; iOS is on the App Store and Android is on Google Play.

## Platforms

Funput runs on:

- iOS — Vietnamese keyboard for iPhone and iPad; requires iOS/iPadOS 18.6+; available on the App Store
- Android — Vietnamese keyboard for phones and tablets; requires Android 8.0 (API 26)+; available on Google Play
- macOS — native input method; requires macOS 26 (Tahoe)+; ready to download
- Windows — native input method; requires Windows 10 version 1809+ or Windows 11; ready to download
- Linux — native input method (Fcitx5 and IBus); install guide: https://docs.funput.app/docs/install/linux/

## Features

- Telex and VNI Vietnamese typing
- Native desktop integration on macOS, Windows, and Linux
- Native mobile keyboards for iOS and Android
- Platform-specific UI for each operating system
- Lightweight, privacy-focused, free and open source (MIT)
- Built with Rust

## Official app pages

- [Funput for macOS](https://funput.app/macos/): Vietnamese input method for macOS 26+, Apple Silicon and Intel; .pkg or .app.zip.
- [Funput for Windows](https://funput.app/windows/): Vietnamese input method for Windows 10 version 1809+ and Windows 11; portable x86-64 .exe.
- [Funput for Linux](https://funput.app/linux/): Vietnamese input method for Fcitx5 and IBus; Ubuntu, Debian, Fedora, openSUSE and Arch on x86-64.
- [Funput for iOS](https://funput.app/ios/): Vietnamese keyboard for iPhone and iPad; App Store ID 6788829996.
- [Funput for Android](https://funput.app/android/): Vietnamese keyboard for phones and tablets; Google Play package app.funput.funput.
- [Introducing Funput](https://funput.app/blog/funput-la-gi/): Vietnamese introduction to Funput, Telex/VNI, supported devices and official downloads.
- [Telex, VNI and advanced Telex](https://funput.app/blog/telex-vni-va-telex-nang-cao/): Vietnamese typing guide with key mappings, examples and Funput advanced Telex shortcuts.
- [Set up Funput on iPhone and iPad](https://funput.app/blog/cach-bat-ban-phim-funput-iphone-ipad/): Illustrated keyboard setup, Full Access explanation and troubleshooting.
- [Install Funput on Windows](https://funput.app/blog/cai-funput-windows-10-11/): Windows 10/11 portable setup, typing methods, system tray, troubleshooting and updates.
- [Blog](https://funput.app/blog/): Published updates from Funput.
- [Move from Windows to Linux](https://funput.app/blog/chuyen-windows-sang-linux-go-tieng-viet/): Keep familiar Telex/VNI typing with Funput, configure Fcitx5 or IBus and verify everyday workflows.
- [A modern Vietnamese input method for Linux](https://funput.app/blog/bo-go-tieng-viet-linux-hien-dai/): Funput features, package updates, maintenance evaluation and practical migration checks.
- [Choose a Vietnamese input method](https://funput.app/blog/chon-bo-go-tieng-viet/): Device compatibility, Telex/VNI, practical typing checks and official Funput downloads.
- [Set up Funput on Android](https://funput.app/blog/cai-ban-phim-tieng-viet-android/): Enable and select the keyboard, choose Telex/VNI, adjust layout and troubleshoot setup.
- [Unicode, TCVN3 and VNI-Windows](https://funput.app/blog/unicode-tcvn3-vni-windows/): Distinguish typing methods, encodings and fonts; convert Vietnamese text with Funput desktop.
- [Troubleshoot Vietnamese typing](https://funput.app/blog/khong-go-duoc-tieng-viet/): Diagnose keyboard selection, Telex/VNI mismatches and app-specific input problems across Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS and Android.
- [Sitemap](https://funput.app/sitemap-index.xml): Index of public website pages.

## About (Vietnamese)

Funput là bộ gõ tiếng Việt mã nguồn mở dành cho người cần gõ tiếng Việt trên nhiều thiết bị. Bạn có thể dùng Telex hoặc VNI trên iOS, Android, macOS, Windows và Linux — từ máy tính đến điện thoại.

## About (English)

Funput is a free, open-source Vietnamese input method for people who type Vietnamese across devices. It runs on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and Linux, with Telex and VNI support.
Built with Rust under the MIT license by Funput.
